changelog: Plex-style title details with smaller posters, clear gold Play actions, subdued metadata/backdrop, shared desktop library navigation, and responsive season episode thumbnails. Preserves native detail/episode actions and lazy artwork; adds a default-enabled Appearance opt-out and conservative TV/unknown-structure fallbacks. Fixes remaining blue player slider thumbs, volume/settings bars and React accents, and prevents the volume slider collapsing. Honors the configured accent color and global-theme opt-out.
description: A unified cinematic Jellyfin Web customization with a profile-forward login screen, Plex-inspired theme, and rotating library-driven home hero.
name: Cinematic UI
overview: Cinematic login and home experience for Jellyfin Web
